parsed.text: This packet contains location-distribution data for red and blue roles on 4×4 local grids at four addressed nodes, separated into two panels (p0, p1). Current estimates (view = current) show for both panels: node n0 — blue mass concentrated on cells (0,2),(0,3),(1,2),(1,3); red mass concentrated on (0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1). Nodes n1 and n2 are uniform in current views. Node n3 in current views has blue peak at (1,1) and red peak at (0,2). Candidate records are conditional (not executed events); native_conditional entries and copied prior records are not new executed estimates. Across conditional commands the main differences occur at node n0 and at some native conditionals in p1: some command-conditioned distributions place red peaks at (0,0) vs (0,2) or concentrate blue more strongly at (0,2). The propositions list gives the exact peak cells for every supplied distribution (candidate and current).
